label: myadhd.my
caption:
Fine at work. Fine with friends. Falling apart the moment you get home.

That is masking, and it costs more than anyone sees. Swipe for why so many only notice it as adults, and three ways to put the mask down.

If this sounded like your brain, come sit with people who get it. Our group is in my bio 👇

Save this for the day you are tired of pretending.

#adhd #adhdmalaysia #myadhd #adhdadult #adhdmasking

slides.title:
Why am I so
tired from
[[acting fine]]?
slides.sub: Looking okay takes energy. A lot of it.

slides.title:
Masking is
[[acting]] fine
slides.body: Nodding along when you lost the thread. Rehearsing a phone call. Five alarms so no one sees you forget. From outside, you look fine. That is the point.

slides.title:
A skill you
[[learned early]]
slides.body: Years of "sit still" and "pay attention" teach you to hide the parts that got you in trouble. It worked. That is why it stuck.

slides.title:
It is why it
was [[missed]]
for so long
slides.body: If you coped well enough, no one looked closer. Many people, often women, only start to recognise themselves as adults, after years of looking fine.

slides.title:
The cost shows
up [[at home]]
slides.body: You hold it together at work and fall apart on the sofa. The people closest to you get the tired version, because that is where the mask comes off.

slides.title:
Find where you
can [[unmask]]
slides.body: One friend, one room, one group where you do not have to perform. Being yourself for an hour a week refills more than any nap.

slides.title:
Drop [[one]]
mask at a time
slides.body: You do not have to stop all at once. Try "sorry, I lost you, can you say that again?" instead of nodding. Small, honest, and lighter.

slides.title:
Plan rest after
[[big rooms]]
slides.body: A wedding, a workshop, a long day of meetings. Book quiet time straight after, the way you would book the ride home. The crash is coming either way.

slides.title:
Save this for the
day you are tired
of [[pretending]]
slides.body: You do not have to earn rest by hiding well. Dump everything into my.adhd and get one thing back, without the performance.
